fusions.name: Charge Home
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 30 damage, always strikes critically and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Kick
fusions.desc: A stamping kick that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Reef Barding
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Keeping Time
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 6%.
